features.name: Manual Setup Page Improvements
features.description: The Manual Setup page has been reorganized and grouped to reduce visual clutter and improve usability. The page is now easier to browse and locate desired setup options.

features.name: Duplicate External Documents Notification
features.description: A notification alerts users when they attempt to enter a sales invoice with an external document number that has already been entered previously.

features.name: Default Quantities for GL Accounts
features.description: A new setting in sales setup allows users to specify default quantities for GL accounts. When selecting a GL account in a sales invoice, the default quantity is automatically filled in.

features.name: Copilot-Assisted Number Series Setup
features.description: Copilot can automatically generate and configure all required number series for a module, such as Purchase and Payables, significantly reducing manual setup time. Users can review and modify generated configurations before applying.

features.name: Phone Number for Custom Ship to Address
features.description: A new phone number field has been added to custom ship to addresses in sales orders to meet regulatory requirements in certain countries and enable contact with delivery destinations.

quotes.text: C-development is the business Central team's ambition to jointly develop the BC business application together with the partner community
quotes.why_it_matters: This defines the core mission of the co-development initiative and the strategic partnership between Microsoft and the partner community.

quotes.text: 2 we have shipped no less than 156 community contributions
quotes.why_it_matters: This establishes a new record for community contributions shipped in a single release, demonstrating the scale and impact of the co-development program.

quotes.text: more than 60 of of these contributions have actually been added by just four community members
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that a few top contributors made most of the contributions.

quotes.text: what used to take you know forever to set up can now be done in the glimpse of an eye
quotes.why_it_matters: This illustrates the productivity impact of copilot-assisted setup, transforming a time-consuming manual task into an automated process.

quotes.text: in order to add this one field 783 objects had to be modified
quotes.why_it_matters: This demonstrates the technical complexity of adding even simple functionality to the base product and why community contributions to the platform are valuable.
